name: outage_loso_v2_detail
label: C: EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0) and HURDAT2; 24 storms, storm-grouped LOSO; hindcast, observed track: features of the held-out storm come from its post-season HURDAT2 best track, not from the forecasts available at the time, so the errors understate operational forecast error
headline: two results: S (pool V1-V4 fixed before any run: the gradient-boosted model) and S2 (pool V1, V3, V5-V7; V6, V7 and the pool registered after round 1 had shown the fitted fragility curve B3 best). S2 equals B3 on most storms (blend weight 0), so S2's gain over the wind threshold is the fitted curve's, not the gradient-boosted model's

sensitivity_2018_on_refit.note: 2016-2017 storms dropped from training and testing (sparser EAGLE-I reporting)
